scripts.build:all: pnpm -r build && pnpm install && pnpm link-bins && pnpm --filter=fbtee build:fbtee-strings && pnpm copy-files && (cd example && pnpm fbtee:all) && (cd website && pnpm fbtee:all)
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/lib packages/fbtee/lib-tmp && pnpm --dir example clean
scripts.copy-files: find packages/* -type d -maxdepth 0 -exec cp README.md LICENSE {} \;
scripts.dev: cd example && pnpm fbtee:all && pnpm dev
scripts.jest:oxc: pnpm --filter @nkzw/oxc-transform-fbtee test && pnpm --filter @nkzw/vite-plugin-fbtee test && pnpm --filter @nkzw/next-plugin-fbtee test && FBTEE_JEST_COMPILER=oxc NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --experimental-vm-modules --no-warnings" node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects fbtee example --runInBand --no-cache
scripts.jest:parity: pnpm --filter @nkzw/babel-plugin-fbtee build && pnpm --filter @nkzw/babel-plugin-fbtee-auto-import build && pnpm --filter @nkzw/oxc-transform-fbtee build && NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --experimental-vm-modules --no-warnings" node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects compiler-parity --runInBand --no-cache
scripts.link-bins: pnpm --dir packages/fbtee rebuild && pnpm --dir example rebuild && pnpm --dir website rebuild
scripts.preinstall: command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath git-hooks || exit 0
scripts.shear: command -v cargo-shear >/dev/null 2>&1 || cargo install cargo-shear --version 1.12.4 --locked; cargo shear
scripts.ship: pnpm --filter @nkzw/oxc-transform-fbtee download:artifacts && pnpm clean && pnpm build:all && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @nkzw/oxc-transform-fbtee assemble:artifacts && pnpm --filter @nkzw/oxc-transform-fbtee verify:artifacts && pnpm publish -r --access public
scripts.test: npm-run-all --parallel lint jest tsc:check lint:format shear
